maddeler.e:
أزدهر (form VIII)
# أَزْدَهِرُ (ʔazdahiru) /ʔaz.da.hi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَهَرَ (izdahara)
# أَزْدَهِرَ (ʔazdahira) /ʔaz.da.hi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَهَرَ (izdahara)
# أَزْدَهِرْ (ʔazdahir) /ʔaz.da.hir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِزْدَهَرَ (izdahara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
